name: pawn-forge
description: Turns Claude into a SA-MP / open.mp engineer: real Pawn compiler in the loop, static analysis for buffer overflows, SQL injection and resource leaks, CrashDetect log triage, verified vehicle/skin/weapon/animation IDs, exact API signatures, SA-MP to open.mp migration, TextDraw scaffolding and headless y_testing runs.

python_command.title: Python command
python_command.description: Command that runs Python 3.8+. Use python3 on macOS/Linux; on Windows use py or python.

pawncc_path.title: pawncc path (optional)
pawncc_path.description: Full path to pawncc / pawncc.exe. Leave empty to auto-detect (project qawno/ or pawno/, PATH, or the install_compiler tool).

include_paths.title: Extra include directories (optional)
include_paths.description: Additional include directories, separated by ':' on macOS/Linux or ';' on Windows. Project include/, qawno/include, pawno/include and sampctl dependencies/ are found automatically.

lint_on_edit.title: Lint Pawn files after each edit
lint_on_edit.description: Run the pawn-forge linter on the lines Claude just changed in .pwn/.inc files and feed findings back to Claude.
